# NLTK Porter stemmer

q4t embeds the NLTK 3.9.2 Porter stemmer for the isolated English METEOR grader. This copy removes the NLTK abstract base-class import and interactive corpus demonstration. The algorithm and its default NLTK extensions are retained. The service uses its existing disposable CPython worker. [Upstream source](https://github.com/nltk/nltk/blob/3.9.2/nltk/stem/porter.py) · [License](LICENSE.txt)
